"""One-shot rename pass for harbor.accounts.fetch_user -> load_account + include_deleted -> with_deleted."""
import re
import pathlib

ROOT = pathlib.Path(".")

SKIP_DIRS = {"legacy_cache", "third_party", "logs", ".git"}

# Files handled by hand (own unrelated fetch_user definitions).
SKIP_FILES = {"harbor/admin/shell.py", "harbor/integrations/sync.py", "harbor/accounts/__init__.py"}

RULES = [
    # getattr(accounts, "fetch_user") -> getattr(accounts, "load_account")
    (re.compile(r'getattr\(accounts, "fetch_user"\)'), 'getattr(accounts, "load_account")'),
    # handler strings: "harbor.accounts:fetch_user" (not fetch_user_count)
    (re.compile(r'(?<![\w.])harbor(\.\w+)+:fetch_user\b'), lambda m: m.group(0)[:-len("fetch_user")] + "load_account"),
    # mock.patch / dotted targets rooted at harbor: "harbor.x.y.fetch_user"
    (re.compile(r'(?<![\w.])harbor(?:\.\w+)+\.fetch_user\b(?![\w.])'),
     lambda m: m.group(0)[:-len("fetch_user")] + "load_account"),
    # accounts.fetch_user / acct.fetch_user as attribute lookups (not metric names)
    (re.compile(r'\baccounts\.fetch_user\b(?![\w.])'), "accounts.load_account"),
    (re.compile(r'\bacct\.fetch_user\b(?![\w.])'), "acct.load_account"),
    # from harbor.accounts import fetch_user[...]
    (re.compile(r'(from harbor\.accounts import )fetch_user\b'), r"\1load_account"),
    # remaining bare name: calls, import items, loader defaults
    (re.compile(r'\bfetch_user\b(?![\w.])'), "load_account"),
]

changed = {}


def transform_line(line):
    if line.lstrip().startswith("#"):
        return line
    original = line
    for pattern, repl in RULES:
        line = pattern.sub(repl, line)
    if line != original:
        return line
    return line


def main():
    for p in sorted(pathlib.Path("harbor").rglob("*.py")) + sorted(pathlib.Path("tests").rglob("*.py")):
        s = str(p)
        parts = s.split("/")
        if parts[0] in SKIP_DIRS or s in SKIP_FILES:
            continue
        if s.startswith("harbor/proto/") and s.endswith("_pb2.py"):
            continue
        text = p.read_text()
        if "fetch_user" not in text:
            continue
        lines = text.splitlines(keepends=True)
        out = [transform_line(line) for line in lines]
        new = "".join(out)
        if new != text:
            p.write_text(new)
            changed[s] = sum(1 for a, b in zip(lines, out) if a != b)
    for k in sorted(changed):
        print(f"{changed[k]:4d} {k}")
    print("files changed:", len(changed))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
